failure_analysis.mitigation: Inspect crypto-check logs; use timeout and partial-report fallback.
Inspect secret-hunter logs; keep scan result with unavailable-service marker.
Inspect network-inspector logs; continue with static-only findings.
Use MASVS rule fallback or regenerate suggestions.
